cpu_active_only.semantics: 1 Hz interval statistics, not instantaneous peaks or repeat confidence intervals. Intervals outside 0.5–2.5 s are excluded from peaks/near-95% durations. 95% is a descriptive warning threshold, not proof of CPU saturation. Process CPU sums all threads; tick-thread CPU was not collected separately. Per-core CPU includes all processes on that core; the tick thread may migrate. Executing CPU excludes idle/iowait/steal; steal is reported separately.

matched_comparison.semantics: Collector-only condition. V2 sequence-window retries have no 60-second TTL and are not interchangeable with v1 retry totals. Single observations with entropy-seeded Worlds. Bins condition on time/population, not equal entity layout. Inner timestamp boundaries and actual offered/entity load are retained. No causal confidence intervals or capacity claim. Maxima remain cumulative. Empty wire tails are null.

flow_summary.retry_semantics: Observed repeated reliable sequence within a 32768-sequence sliding window per direction/port/channel; nearest-half-range extension from observed data only; no time TTL. Assumes no unseen advance of 32768 or more and no port reuse. First means first observed in retained window, not proven original transmission. Not equivalent to v1 60-second history.

limits.world_seed: World is entropy seeded; bot seed 30 does not fix its trajectory.
limits.sequence_assumptions: No unseen data-command sequence advance >=32768, and no port reuse; neither can be proven from these compact artifacts. ACKs do not advance history. Exactly half-range observations are unclassified.
limits.map_defect: Pinned ConnectAuth encoder writes u32 character_id at bytes 4..8 before str8 name at offset 8. Collector reads name_len from offset 4, which is zero for unsigned bots; no mapping is emitted. Real name starts at offset 9. Existing synthetic test omits character_id.
limits.wire_semantics: Game capture observes interface arrivals before UDP socket drops, not application-delivered inputs. Nonzero port-seconds exclude silent seconds and include joins; no identity validation pass.
limits.read_gap_semantics: Time between receive attempts, including normal sleep; not receive-queue residence.
limits.delivery_age_semantics: Application-observed time since last message, not one-way network latency.
limits.capture_eof_semantics: EOF proves pipe completion only. Packet counts, timestamps, kernel loss, mappings, and controller termination are checked independently.
limits.bin_semantics: Equal 10ms timestamps are merged. Empty 10ms bins with no traffic are absent, so reported distributions condition on observed bins; peaks remain observed maxima.
